1.0.0.description:
The first public release. Taz: Wanted (PS2) on PCSX2, connected to
Archipelago over PINE.

**Download `tazwanted.apworld` below**, double-click it, and Archipelago
installs it. Setup guide is on the
[repo front page](https://github.com/imklubb/Archipelago-Taz-Wanted).

## What gets randomized

**168 locations** at default settings, up to **552** with the interval
options turned up:

- 70 Wanted Posters
- 45 Catchers
- 10 Golden Sam statues
- 10 Level Completions
- 10 Sandwich checks (every 100 by default; every 5 gives 200)
- 10 Destruction checks (every 50% by default; every 5% gives 200)
- 9 Bonus games
- 4 Boss defeats

**Items:** 10 Level Unlocks, 5 Boss Unlocks, 9 Bonus Game Unlocks,
11 Costumes, 5 filler types and 6 traps.

## Two modes

**Open** shuffles level access into the multiworld. Every level, boss,
costume and bonus game is an item, and you choose what the goal requires:
Wanted Posters, boss defeats, the Hindenbird's unlock, or any combination.

**Linear** leaves the game's own progression alone. Levels unlock as they
normally would, but each boss sits behind a Wanted Poster count you set.
Costumes and bonus games are still shuffled.

## Features

- **An in-client map tab** with all eleven maps and 195 pins, so you do not
  have to run a second program
- **DeathLink**, with a configurable amnesty
- **In-game text** through the game's own string table and banner: locked
  levels read LOCKED on the hub signs, boss doors say what they are waiting
  for, and the Hindenbird shows your remaining goal
- **Traps** — Dynamite, Squash, Electrocute, Hiccup, No Spinning and Costume
  Strip. Off by default. They land whatever Taz is doing, spinning included,
  the same way the game's own hazards do
- **A flight recorder** in `logs/`, which records far more than the client
  window shows — the first thing to attach to a bug report

## 32 yaml options

Game mode, starting levels, goal conditions and thresholds, four poster gates,
poster pool size, sandwich and destruction intervals, difficulty, per-item
filler weights, trap percentage, in-game text verbosity, local filler,
DeathLink and its amnesty.

## Before you start

**Set the in-game Daffy-culty to match your yaml.** Some checks are
unreachable on a lower one. The client warns you, but by then some may already
be gone.

## Requirements

- Archipelago 0.6.4 or newer
- PCSX2 2.0 or newer with PINE enabled (Settings → Advanced, slot 28011)
- A Taz: Wanted (PS2) disc image, `SLUS-20236`

Contains no part of the game. You supply your own disc image.

## Tracker

[Taz-Wanted-Poptracker](https://github.com/imklubb/Taz-Wanted-Poptracker) —
install once and PopTracker keeps it updated by itself.
1.0.0.title: Taz: Wanted AP 1.0.0

1.0.1.description:
# New
- Slippery Trap! Makes every ground slippery for 20 seconds!

# Bug Fixes
- The Load and Select File text on the client now appear when you load into the Main Menu instead of immediately.
- Getting Bubble Gum while on a slippery surface no longer keeps Taz slippery or Freezes him
